name: DarkQuest
summary: DarkQuest is a named dark-sector upgrade proposal on the SeaQuest/SpinQuest beamline at the Fermilab Main Injector, Illinois. Existing SeaQuest running must not be counted as completed DarkQuest data-taking.
detection_principle: A 120 GeV proton fixed target and existing magnetic spectrometer seek visible long-lived-dark-particle decays behind a beam dump; an added electromagnetic calorimeter extends electron/photon final-state sensitivity.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
